name: INPS Biodiversity Grants
summary: Small grants for ecological management or restoration of natural areas open to the public (invasive removal, prairie planting, acquisition) and for native plant demonstration gardens. Paid after the project report.
reporting: A final report with a description and photos of the completed project, due by 1 December; the award is paid after it is approved.

calls.label: Annual application window
calls.recurring: The application form opens 1 January and closes 1 February each year.

status.quote: The form is available yearly starting January 1 and closing February 1.

recurring.quote: The form is available yearly starting January 1 and closing February 1.

access.quote: Applicants must submit their proposal online using the INPS Biodiversity Grant Application form.

reporting.quote: Grant award is distributed upon receiving and approving the project report, which must be received by December 1.
